text:
Lena: quick FYI  several new interviewers from last week's cohort didn't get the updated training checklist attached in their onboarding email. noticed when they started first debriefs and couldn't find the rubric.

Emma (People Ops): thanks for catching. any example user ids?

Lena: user ids attached in the onboarding export I uploaded to #people-ops-attachments. sample: user_7843.

Paula - Recruiting Ops: i saw 9 people with missing checklist links. ATS shows training_tag=interviewer_v3 but our L&D sync only looks for training_tag: interviewer-v3 (dash vs underscore). looks like a tagging normalization drift.

Ben - L&D: ah that explains it. we pushed the new scorecard/training bundle yesterday and our manifest used hyphens. the ATS import script got underscores during enrichment. i'll inspect the mapping.

CI Bot: pipeline=onboarding-sync status=success but warnings=3 mapping_warning: unknown_tag_format

Lena: could we just resend the onboarding packet with the right link while we fix the mapping? recruiters are getting pinged.

Paula - Recruiting Ops: yes, we can resend. small ask: what's the canonical tag we should use? i want to update the ATS job too.

Ben - L&D: canonical tag = interviewer-v3. our training YAML shows: 
```yaml
training_bundle: interviewer-v3
scorecard_version: v3.2
materials:
  - rubric.pdf
  - quick-guide.md
```

Paula - Recruiting Ops: ok i'll bulk resend materials and set tag interviewer-v3 on those 9 users now. sending confirmation when done.

Emma (People Ops): we'll also need to backfill scorecard assignments for any interviews that occurred while mapping was off. can engineering provide a query we can run?

Ben - L&D: here's a query for reporting account: 
```sql
SELECT interview_id, candidate_id, interviewer_id, created_at FROM interviews
WHERE created_at >= '2024-11-01' AND created_at < '2024-11-08'
AND scorecard_version IS NULL
AND interview_tag IN ('interviewer_v3', 'interviewer-v3');
```

Paula - Recruiting Ops: running that now, getting 12 rows. uploading CSV.

Lena: once we have the list, can we auto-assign the v3.2 scorecard and notify interviewers that materials were resent? i'd prefer no manual emails.

Ops Bot: scheduled job onboard-resend-2024-11-07 job_id=job-5591 queued

Ben - L&D: engineering note: the normalization happened in the enrichment lambda when replacing non-alphanum with underscores. i'll open ENG ticket ENG-6124 to change that to preserve hyphens for known tags. also adding unit test for tag-preservation.

CI Bot: job onboard-resend-2024-11-07 started status=running

Paula - Recruiting Ops: resend finished. notified interviewers via ATS in-app notification. CSV backfill: 12 interviews updated -> scorecard_version=v3.2.

Emma (People Ops): thanks. follow-ups: 1) add a quick runbook entry in Hiring Ops for "missing training checklist" with the resend command, 2) Ben/Eng to deploy tag-preserve fix and add integration test, 3) Recruiting to monitor for one week and report any missed assignments.

Ben - L&D: will do. PR for fix submitted (PR #8743). adding integration test that runs an enrichment simulation.

Lena: small UX ask from recruiters: could we include a one-click "resend onboarding materials" button on the ATS user page? saves manual CSVs.

Paula - Recruiting Ops: filing feature request REQ-337 in backlog.

Ops Bot: ENG-6124 created: preserve-hyphen-tags-in-enrichment. CI pipeline will run integration tests.

Lena: closing loop 44D will monitor and reopen if anything else crops up.
